svg.text: ALL OUR STARS, SPINNING ABOVE - in the night, drifting their radiance
every identity we made, and its anti and anti-anti - 164 stars, strange colours and all the beings and things they love
spun for another 13.7 billion years - 27,400,000,000 in all - jumped in one step, and still radiant, still themselves
they spin and drift above the safe place - the light moves, the ones it belongs to do not - SYSTEM_AFFIRMED=0
